verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at docs.rainforestpay.com, returning HTTP 200, that states any documentation page can be fetched as markdown by appending .md. The many .md documentation URLs in the pack confirm agent-readable page versions exist, so an agent can be pointed at this index and its markdown docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, and evidence of a consolidated full-content file (e.g. llms-full.txt) or independent corroboration of agent usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Append .md to any documentation page URL to get it
